heading: Things people usually want to know.
intro: Straight answers on how we work, what to expect, and where QOL Works fits in.
ask_text: Ask us directly — a short note is enough.

questions.question: Do we have to replace our existing systems?
questions.answer: Almost never. We typically build alongside your ERP, CRM, POS, WMS or healthcare platform and move information between them. Replacement is the last option we recommend, not the first.

questions.question: How small can a first project be?
questions.answer: We can start small. Many customers begin with a focused use case or single location to prove value quickly, then expand from there.

questions.question: What do you need from us to start?
questions.answer: A clear goal, access to the right stakeholders, and a small working group. We’ll help define the scope and handle the rest.

questions.question: Do you work with our existing IT team or replace them?
questions.answer: We work with your team, not around them. Our role is to complement your internal IT and bring specialized expertise where it’s needed.

questions.question: Where does AI actually come in?
questions.answer: AI is used where it creates real value — like automating manual work, surfacing insights from your data, and improving decisions. It’s practical, not experimental.

questions.question: What happens after the first project ships?
questions.answer: We measure impact, refine what’s working, and scale to additional teams, locations or use cases. Our goal is a long-term partnership, not a one-off project.
